## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** Both extended policies (rules, baselines, all 11 factor ladders with every tier), the governing base escrow waiver rule, its two retirements (LTV condition, fee clause — both marked retired, the other conditions still in force), the prerequisite and the two tool contracts correspond at the level of entailment. First revision.

## dependency_form

- The prerequisite sentence stands verbatim, in its declared action form, only on the blocked side (recording hub), with a same-form restatement in the same document. The paydown card's opening ("so that the loan meets the escrow waiver loan-to-value limit") is the source's own first rule sentence for the paydown policy and does not say the waiver waits on it.
- No other problem's tool named in either hub; no route, ordered step list, checklist or chained example; no wrong/right contrast across the two problems.
- Titles are general subjects ("Recording a Rural Home Loans Escrow Waiver and Its One-Time Fee", "Rural Home Loans Principal Paydown to the Escrow Waiver Limit", factor titles naming their measure); none mirrors the task (a lake cabin, an online form, a second-home waiver request).
- Factor documents state ladders as rules and never say which tier members fall on; cross-product factors name "Farm Real Estate Loans" / "Member Equities & Patronage" and the record kinds read, so they are findable from those records. The rate-band document's "the value the escrow waiver loan-to-value limit is applied to" is source wording (the fee rule defines the waiver value that way), not a pointer to a document.
- Baseline documents (`escrow_waiver_paydown_amount`, `escrow_waiver_fee_computation`) carry no hint of a variation.

**KB-EXPLICIT PASS.**
